headline: Cloverleaf Mechanical (Cloverleaf Heating, Air & Plumbing), Springfield, OH
summary: Cloverleaf Mechanical LLC is a heating and cooling contractor at 1230 Mitchell Blvd. in Springfield (Clark County), Ohio, that now markets itself as Cloverleaf Heating, Air & Plumbing. The Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board roster we downloaded on October 22, 2026 shows its HVAC contractor license, HV.22959, as active through March 31, 2027, with Ronald E. The company's site says ownership changed in August 2025, when Jonathon, whose family has run SouthTowne Plumbing, took over and added plumbing to Cloverleaf's HVAC work.
